evidenceBoundary: The compiled Projects Companion runs in local Chromium with a deterministic app.request bridge fixture. Assertions prove rendered UI state, request payloads, optimistic rollback, and user retries; they do not prove the Projects backend/database, Core proxy, real coordinator or worker execution, webhook delivery, or Ryu Spaces synchronization.
